title: Velvety Smoky Brazilian Cheese Skewers
description: A smoky, crumbly, romantic Brazilian dish featuring single cream and score-fat, perfect for a night in with loved ones.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the single cream, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Cut the queijo coalho into 1-inch cubes and add to the bowl, tossing to coat with the cream mixture.
Thread 2-3 cheese cubes onto each bamboo skewer, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the cheese is melted and slightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley and a drizzle of score-fat.
Repeat with the remaining cheese and skewers.
Let the skewers rest for 1-2 minutes before serving.
